name: Ride Quest: Car Savings Game
subtitle: Budget + save for your car
promotionalText: Saving for a car shouldn't feel like a chore. Set your goal, log spending, and level up as your savings grow, with quests, boss fights and an arcade.
description:
Ride Quest turns saving for a car into a retro arcade game. Set a savings goal, keep your monthly budgets, and watch your pixel car get closer to the keys with every dollar you put away.

YOUR QUEST
Name your goal and set the amount and the month you want it by. A neon dial shows how far you've come, and every 10% unlocks a new level, all the way to QUEST CLEAR.

BUDGETS THAT FEEL LIKE A GAME
Set a monthly limit for each category: groceries, gas, eating out, car care and anything else you like. Health bars show what's left, a donut shows where the money went, and a heat map and six-month chart show your habits. Budget alerts warn you before a category runs out.

LOG IN SECONDS
Quick add a purchase or move money between checking, savings and cash. Every entry lands in your money log, and transfers track what you've stashed for the goal.

MONTHLY REVIEW
This month versus last month by category, income versus spending, your savings pace toward the goal, your top merchants and the bills coming up next.

FIND EVERY SUBSCRIPTION
Track every subscription and what it costs a month and a year. Paste a list to add them all at once, mark the ones to cancel, and see the subscriptions Ride Quest spots in your bank activity.

THE ARCADE
Daily quests, challenges, boss fights against your spendiest categories, a pixel garage, a road trip map, rank and streaks, a pit-stop reaction game, and a loot chest for every week you hit your savings goal. Just for fun: no real money, prizes or purchases.

OPTIONAL BANK SYNC
Connect your bank through SimpleFIN Bridge (a separate paid service you sign up for) and purchases log themselves. Your access key is kept in the iPhone Keychain and the app talks to SimpleFIN directly. No bank? Everything works by hand.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics, no servers. Your budget lives on your iPhone, with a backup you can export any time.

Free, with nothing to buy. Ride Quest is a budgeting tool, not financial advice, and is not affiliated with any bank or car brand.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in, nothing to buy. Everything works offline by hand: Setup sets the goal and balances, Quick add (+) logs a purchase.

Bank sync is optional and needs the user's own SimpleFIN Bridge account (a third-party paid service, simplefin.org). The setup token is exchanged on the device; the access URL is stored only in the Keychain. Reviewers can skip it: every feature works without it.

The Arcade games (including a slot-machine style reward spinner) use no real money, have no prizes and cannot be paid for.

shots.sub: Your car savings goal, as a game.
This month vs last, income vs spending.
Monthly and yearly cost, and which to cancel.
Quests, streaks and loot for hitting your goal.
Quick add, transfers and optional bank sync.
